instruction: Insert the image "none.png" from the Desktop into slide 1 of the presentation, resized to 3cm wide and 2cm tall.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to slide 2, inserted none.png via Insert > Image menu, then resized the image to 1cm x 1cm using the Position and Size panel.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select slides in panel, use Insert > Image menu to add images, navigate file dialog, resize images using Position and Size properties.
metadata.task_rationale: Varies the target slide (slide 1 instead of slide 2) and uses different non-square dimensions (3cm x 2cm) to test the model's ability to handle asymmetric sizing.
metadata.explanation: Custom getter reads slide 1 image properties from the pptx. Metric checks if at least one image exists with 3cm width and 2cm height (0.05cm tolerance). Partial credit: 0.5 for image presence, 0.5 for correct size.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads slide 1 (index 0) and extracts all PICTURE shape dimensions with correct EMU-to-cm conversion (1 cm = 360000 EMU).
Metric correctly accesses expected parameter directly (expected.get('expected_width_cm')) which is correct for type='rule' since framework passes rules dict directly.
Partial credit logic is sensible: 0.5 for image presence on slide, 0.5 for correct dimensions (3cm x 2cm with 0.05cm tolerance).
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads it, ensuring fresh state.

Minor gap: Evaluator does not verify that the inserted image is specifically 'none.png' — it only checks that any image on slide 1 has the right dimensions. If the slide already had a pre-existing image with matching dimensions, it would pass incorrectly.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider checking the image name or blob hash to verify that the specific file 'none.png' was inserted, not just any image with matching dimensions.
